notes.title: Pay What You Want for the Season's Beatings soundtrack!
notes.content:
The Season's Beatings OST by [url=https://twitter.com/DeanCutty]Dean Cutsforth[/url] is available now on [url=https://deancutsforth.bandcamp.com/album/seasons-beatings-ost-2]Bandcamp[/url]!

Head on over to https://deancutsforth.bandcamp.com/album/seasons-beatings-ost-2 to pick it up.

Included are the 3 rockin' in-game tracks, PLUS the classic holiday jingle from the main menu. All available to stream/download for whatever price you deem appropriate. It's pay what you want, but please consider "wanting" to pay at least a little something to support our friend Dean Cutsforth directly. :D

And check out some of Dean's other work while you're there. The song 'Teeth' from his album [url=https://deancutsforth.bandcamp.com/album/see-saw-2]See-Saw[/url] is one of my favorite songs of all time.

And don't forget to buy [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/749410/Seasons_Beatings/]Season's Beatings[/url]!
